messages:
sam: FYI customer ClearBlue asked to onboard Lumina-7B on Private (eu-west). Wants gen latency <=200ms (p50/p95) and prefer 4-bit quant. Can we triage?
anya: Do we have HF link + license? Instruction tuned or vanilla?
sam: HF: https://huggingface.co/clearblue/lumina-7b v1.2.0. License looks permissive. No customer finetune, they plan instruction-style chat. Tokenizer: 50k BPE.
kevin: Quick checklist: arch is gpt-like? KV cache layout? Params ~7B? Any fused/rotary differences that break our runtimes?
marta: did a quick local smoke quant run — AWQ 4-bit shows a notable drop on our instruction eval. Short paste: ```AWQ4: instr-F1 -8.3
GPTQ4: instr-F1 -3.1
8bit (LLM-int8): instr-F1 -0.8```
ryan: We should run delta-eval vs our baseline (baseline-7b-stable), hallucination probes, and latency on T4/A10g. Infra: can you spin ephemeral infra in eu-west?
infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled ephemeral cluster 'lumina-intake-1' (eu-west) with 4 x a10g, expires in 6h — https://ci.internal/cluster/4723
anya: Plan: (1) delta-eval vs baseline-7b-stable on instruction set (2) hallucination probe set (3) streaming + kv-cache long-seq smoke (4) cost profile + token throughput. I'll own running evals and collating deltas.
kevin: Also add tokenizer mismatch tests — last time we saw off-by-one prompt ends. Include ClearBlue sample prompts (short chat, long context, code blocks). @marta can you run per-channel vs per-tensor quant and a prompt-sensitivity sweep?
marta: On it. I'll run GPTQ4 + AWQ4 + INT8 variants with prompt-sens tests. ETA ~4h. If instr-F1 drop >5% vs baseline, recommendation = avoid 4-bit for hosted; consider 8-bit or Dedicated only.
sam: Customer also asked about SLA and cost. We should surface tradeoffs: hosted with 8-bit (lower risk, higher cost) vs private/dedicated with experimental 4-bit (better cost but monitoring + fallback). @anya please loop product for pricing language.
anya: Will ping product (separately). For triage: priority = high (customer needs in ~3 weeks).
infra-bot: audit-log: user sam created thread 4723456789 - intake lumina-7b
kevin: :thumbsup: Assigning: marta -> quant experiments; anya -> delta-eval + pricing notes; ryan -> infra perf tests. We'll reconvene in #eng-ml in ~6h to review numbers and decide rollout (canary vs full).
